item.title: Marvel Rivals developers are planning to go after cosmetic-hungry farmers, with players hoping the disruptors finally "touch grass"
item.description: Marvel Rivals is currently enjoying a boost in its player numbers following the long-awaited debut of Deadpool, but some players continue to ruin the fun for everyone. Thankfully, the developers of the game are on the case and planning to ult them into oblivion soon enough. Read more

item.description: Far Cry 3: Classic Edition will be getting itself a lovely performance boost later this week. Read more

item.description: Former Assassin's Creed leader Marc-Alexis Côté is reportedly suing Ubisoft following a surprise and suspicious departure from the company last year. Read more

item.title: Hytale's modding scene is off to a great start as Minecraft can now be run inside the sandbox RPG
item.description: It's safe to say Hytale is 2026's biggest indie hit so far, with the game securely funding the next two years of development before it was even out into early access last week. It seems the idea of a proper competitor to Minecraft was a golden one, but that isn't stopping modders and passionate tinkerers from putting Minecraft inside Hytale. Read more

item.title: Following an earlier Xbox leak, Marathon's release date has been locked in
item.description: UPDATE 4.12pm: And it is confirmed. Marathon releases on 5th March, across Xbox Series X/S, PS5 and PC via Steam. Read more

item.title: "Even we can get swept up in the negativity" - Pocketpair reflects on the good, the bad and the ugly for Palworld's second anniversary
item.description: Cast your minds back to this day two years ago, and you will recall Pocketpair's creature catching survival game Palworld taking the internet and players by storm. Read more

item.title: Dynasty Warriors: Origins is big enough, dense enough, and (nearly) successful enough to warrant two sequels, instead of just one
item.description: 2025's Dynasty Warriors: Origins, which has just celebrated its first anniversary, was generally considered a big success and a much-needed evolution of the long-running hack-and-slash series. Later this week, the Visions of Four Heroes DLC and its Nintendo Switch 2 port are launching, and a recent interview with producer Tomohiko Sho has teased what might be coming next. Read more

item.title: Resident Evil 5 and Street Fighter actor confirms Tomb Raider: Catalyst role
item.description: Another voice actor has confirmed their participation in upcoming Tomb Raider game, Catalyst. Read more

item.title: Sega reminds us it's not just celebrating Sonic's 35th this year as it breaks out the party hats for another classic series
item.description: Sonic the Hedgehog might be in the spotlight this year as the legendary platformer's 35th anniversary looms, but it's not the only classic Sega series celebrating a major milestone in 2026. Much-loved match-puzzler Puyo Puyo is also turning 35, and the publisher has kicked off its blobby birthday celebrations with new artwork and more. Read more

item.title: Bungie reveals Marathon voice cast and it's full of familiar names from Baldur's Gate 3 and Clair Obscur
item.description: With Marathon's 5th March release date now official, developer Bungie has started sharing other bits of info about its PvPvE extraction shooter, including a lengthy cast list that - with names including Jennifer English and Ben Starr - reads like a bit of a who's who of video game acting talent. Read more
